snippet: The "leverage ratio" indicates the extent of leverage utilized by an ETF, if any. This measure can be expressed as a multiple (e.g., 3x, 2x, 1.5x, 1.25x, or other) or variable, indicating that the leverage ratio can adjust over time. Leverage reflects the strategy and magnitude of leverage employed by an ETF.
excerpt: Leveraged, Leverage ratio, Leverage Leveraged ETFs include a range of funds, each employing different strategies to manage the impact of price movements in underlying assets or indices.
